title: Ruthless Bar Salts White Gummi On Ice 10ml E-Liquid
description: Ruthless Bar Salts White Gummi on Ice is a playful and nostalgic take on a classic confectionary experience, blending bright tropical fruit notes with a crisp menthol exhale. The fruity sweetness creates a smooth and juicy base, while an icy edge adds a pleasing contrast, keeping the flavour refreshingly light without overpowering that irresistible sugary sweetness. Crafted with a 50VG/50PG ratio, this e-liquid strikes a perfect balance between vapour production and flavour intensity, making it ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits and classic vape starter devices. The nicotine salt formulation delivers a silky-smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine satisfaction. Ruthless continues to push the boundaries of flavour innovation, crafting high-quality, standout blends that continue to shape modern vaping. The American brand's Bar Salts collection distils their signature approach to flavours into a nic salt format, tailored for today’s vapers and pod devices.
